Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review.

Preserve the 2026-09-21 aggregate commission as unattributed and keep matching-period costs, budgets, commitments, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and learning thresholds unknown. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue work, or conduct outreach.

Continue existing dated readiness packets for parked scaffold sites. Preserve private and preview-only status; attach ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and explicit blocker evidence. Do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or enter the queue.
